ends.note: ends at the C.H.&D. S.W. R.R. right of way east of Miller

notes: North is up. Bare printed names kept bare: HOFFNER, BORDEN, POWERS, TOWNSEND, ELMORE; MILLER AV. and COLERAIN AV. printed with AV. Borden is printed 50' at Hoffner and north of Powers (measured 49.8 ft) and 45' south of Powers (measured 45.7 ft); width entry gives 45 to match sheet 613. Powers/Borden is the mean of the north-leg (366) and south-leg (345) centrelines. The line at x~60 down the left side is the paper edge. Hoffner (25') has nothing leaving its north side here; Borden ends at it (T). At the top right Colerain's west face runs SSE from the block corner (5948,397); its east face is only a short block corner at (6420,427). Hoffner jogs at Colerain: west of it 25 ft (centre y~347 falling to ~323 at Colerain); east of it (printed 60' on sheet 615) only the south line is on the paper here (block corner (6420,427), line east at y 427), centre taken 30 ft (181 px) north of it, which matches the 6 inch pipe at y~260. Recorded as two T's on the Colerain centreline: west leg (6153,323) and east leg (6113,247), as on sheet 615. Powers is 50 ft west of Borden (onto 613) and 40 ft east of it; it runs on east across the railroad to the edge. Miller Av. (printed 33', measured ~31 ft) runs from Powers (T, block continuous on the north side) south past Townsend to Elmore; on the key map it continues south of Elmore as FOLLETT, so Elmore/Miller is recorded as a cross (south side of Elmore is off the paper, any jog unknown). Elmore: only its north line is on the paper (y~7466); centre taken 25 ft (151 px) south of it. The unnamed 10' alley behind the Powers lots runs from Borden (T, opens on Borden's east face) east to the railroad strip at x~5620. Townsend ends at the railroad right of way (block corners at (4210,5550) and (4090,5790)). Circled numbers are grade elevations. Scale ~6.04 px/ft.
